description: This file defines the BasketViewModelService class, which implements IBasketViewModelService. It provides methods to manage shopping basket view models, including retrieving, creating, mapping basket data, and counting total basket items for a user.

classes.name: BasketViewModelService
classes.description: Service class responsible for handling basket view model operations such as retrieval, creation, mapping, and item count for a user.

methods.name: GetOrCreateBasketForUser
methods.description: Retrieves an existing basket for a user or creates a new one if none exists.

methods.name: CreateBasketForUser
methods.description: Creates a new basket for the specified user.

methods.name: GetBasketItems
methods.description: Transforms a collection of BasketItem entities into a list of BasketItemViewModel objects, including catalog details and image URIs.

methods.name: Map
methods.description: Maps a Basket entity to a BasketViewModel, including its items.

methods.name: CountTotalBasketItems
methods.description: Returns the total number of items in a user's basket.
